name.zh: 单页幻灯片文字墙

mechanism.en: AI slide generators dump whole paragraphs onto one slide (> 120 Latin words or > 280 Chinese chars).
mechanism.zh: AI 生成 PPT 常把整段方案原文直接塞进单页（英文 > 120 词或中文 > 280 字）。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides (`show="0"`) and footers/slide numbers are skipped.

exemplar.bad: Slide 3 packs 215 words of full-sentence prose explaining migration history, rollback scripts, staffing, and Q4 SLA targets.
exemplar.trap: Slide 3 shrinks body font to 9pt so all 215 words fit inside one rounded box.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 headline: 'Zero-downtime migration cut p99 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms' + 3 short metric rows (54 words total); full runbook linked in notes.

name.zh: 单页要点超载（> 6 条）

mechanism.en: Packing more than 6 bullet points onto one slide flattens hierarchy and makes slides unreadable from a distance.
mechanism.zh: 单页堆超过 6 条项目符号，信息主次彻底散架。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides and title/footer shapes are excluded.

exemplar.bad: Slide lists 9 separate top-level bullets covering pricing, onboarding, compliance, SLA, and billing.
exemplar.trap: Slide wraps 9 bullets into 9 tiny pill badges.
exemplar.good: Slide groups commercial terms into 3 columns: Pricing ($49/seat), Onboarding (2 days), SLA (99.95%).

name.zh: PPT 文本框自动缩排（< 80%）

mechanism.en: OOXML `<a:normAutofit fontScale="...">` below 80000 is deterministic proof that copy overflowed its layout box.
mechanism.zh: OOXML 中 `normAutofit fontScale < 80000` 是文案撑破文本框、被强行缩小的确定性证据。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides are skipped; only triggers below 80% scale.

exemplar.bad: <a:normAutofit fontScale="62500" lnSpcReduction="20000"/> on body placeholder
exemplar.trap: Manually hardcode 10pt font so `normAutofit` disappears while text stays illegible.
exemplar.good: <a:noAutofit/> with 42 words set at 18pt and full line spacing

name.zh: 空泛名词幻灯片标题

mechanism.en: Dense content slides titled `Overview` / `Background` / `项目背景` / `概述` waste the top visual slot instead of stating the takeaway.
mechanism.zh: 正文密集页却只用“项目背景/概述/Overview”当标题，没有亮出本页结论。

falsePositiveGuards: Section dividers with <= 25 Latin words and <= 50 CJK chars are exempt.

exemplar.bad: Title: 'Background' (above 65 words detailing 38% cart abandonment on mobile Safari)
exemplar.trap: Title: 'Reimagining Checkout Excellence'
exemplar.good: Title: 'Mobile Safari accounts for 38% of cart abandonment due to 4-step address entry'

name.zh: 跨页幻灯片版式单调

mechanism.en: Generated decks repeat the identical title + single plain-bullet box across 4+ consecutive content slides without any table, chart, or visual diagram.
mechanism.zh: 在 5 页以上内容演示文稿中，连续 4 页及以上全部退化为“标题 + 单纯字要点框”（无图表、无表格、无配图），视觉极度单调。

falsePositiveGuards: Skips hidden slides and short cover/section divider slides (< 12 words and < 25 CJK chars).
Resets run whenever a slide includes a chart (`<c:chart>`), table (`<a:tbl>`), image (`<p:pic>`), or multi-column structure.

exemplar.bad: Slides 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 each contain only a top title and a single bullet list with zero tables, charts, or diagrams.
exemplar.trap: Slides 2–6 keep the same bullet lists but add purple gradient backgrounds.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 turns the comparison bullets into a 3-column table and Slide 5 uses a latency chart.

name.en: Default Purple-Pink AI Gradient & Clipped Gradient Text
name.zh: 默认紫粉渐变与渐变大字

mechanism.en: Default LLM Tailwind/CSS output falls back to indigo/purple/pink neon gradients and `bg-clip-text text-transparent` headlines.
mechanism.zh: 默认前端生成习惯使用蓝紫/紫粉高饱和渐变和 `bg-clip-text` 渐变标题。

falsePositiveGuards: Comments, scripts, and code blocks are masked; solid neutral palettes stay clean.

exemplar.bad: Release Notes v2.4
exemplar.trap: Release Notes v2.4
exemplar.good: Release Notes v2.4

name.zh: 满屏胶囊标签泛滥

mechanism.en: Wrapping > 6 short metadata tokens per view in `rounded-full` / `999px` badges creates visual noise.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆叠超过 6 个 `rounded-full` / `999px` 文字胶囊，淹没真正的状态提示。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts circular avatars/dots (`size-*` or equal `w-N h-N`) and <= 6 pills.

exemplar.bad: 8 adjacent `rounded-full` badges on one card: `Active`, `v2.4`, `US-West`, `SOC2`, `Fast`, `AI`, `Pro`, `Verified`.
exemplar.trap: 8 square pastel badges with 8 emoji icons on one card.
exemplar.good: Plain mono metadata line: `v2.4 · us-west-2 · SOC2` + single status word `degraded` when unhealthy.

name.zh: 三层套盒（框套框套框）

mechanism.en: Generated dashboards stack 3+ nested bordered/shadowed rounded containers around the same data, eating up padding and visual clarity.
mechanism.zh: AI 面板常把同一项内容包进 3 层及以上带边框/阴影/圆角的容器里，层层套盒。

falsePositiveGuards: Single-side dividers (`border-t`, `border-b`) and 1–2 level cards are exempt.

exemplar.bad: 99.98% uptime
exemplar.trap: 99.98% uptime
exemplar.good: Uptime (90d)99.98%

name.zh: 提示词营销徽章

mechanism.en: Generated UI copies hype labels (`AI-Powered`, `Zero Hallucination`, `AI 强力驱动`) straight into eyebrow tags instead of describing the real feature.
mechanism.zh: 界面眉题或徽章直接印出“AI-Powered”“AI 强力驱动”“零幻觉保证”等空洞宣传语。

falsePositiveGuards: Scoped to `ui-text` zone so comments and scripts stay masked.

exemplar.bad:
AI-Powered · Zero Hallucination

Document Checker
exemplar.trap:
Built for Craft · Pure Signal

Document Checker
exemplar.good: Document Linter for Markdown, HTML, DOCX & PPTX

name.zh: 毛玻璃半透明面板滥用

mechanism.en: Repeating `backdrop-blur` / `backdrop-filter: blur(...)` on 3+ panels per view mimics default AI glassmorphism dashboards and degrades legibility.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆砌 3 处及以上 `backdrop-blur` / `backdrop-filter: blur(` 毛玻璃面板，呈现典型生成式模板腔。

falsePositiveGuards: Allows 1–2 legitimate uses (e.g., sticky top nav + modal overlay).

exemplar.bad:
Nav
A
B
exemplar.trap: A
exemplar.good: <header class="backdrop-blur-sm bg-white/90">Nav</header><section class="bg-white border">Body</section>

name.zh: 侧边粗彩条卡片堆叠

mechanism.en: Stacking 3+ `border-l-4` / `border-left: 4px solid` KPI cards replicates boilerplate AI admin dashboards.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆叠 3 处及以上左侧粗彩条卡片（`border-l-4` / `border-left: >=4px solid`），呈现典型 AI 后台面板套路。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts `blockquote` selectors/tags and <= 2 occurrences per file.

exemplar.bad:
KPI 1
KPI 2
KPI 3
exemplar.trap: KPI 1
exemplar.good: KPI 1

name.en: Process-Label Slide Headline Instead of Finding
name.zh: 过程标签式标题（缺结论句）

mechanism.en: Executive slide headings say 'Analysis of Q3 Churn' or '关于……的分析汇报' instead of stating the conclusion and delta.
mechanism.zh: 管理层汇报标题只写“关于……的分析汇报”，把听众最关心的结论埋进小字里。

falsePositiveGuards: Matches explicit process-label heading prefixes ('Analysis of...', '关于...的分析汇报'); assertion headings pass cleanly.

exemplar.bad: ## 关于三季度新客首周流失率的分析汇报
exemplar.trap: ## 重塑新客留存增长飞轮
exemplar.good: ## 三季度简化实名认证步骤后，新客首周流失率从 34% 降至 19%

name.en: Ambient Blur Orbs, Neon Glows & Pulsing Pill Dots
name.zh: 环境光晕球、霓虹发光阴影与闪烁圆点

mechanism.en: Default LLM landing pages float `blur-3xl` radial glow orbs behind heroes, attach colored neon box-shadows, animate `animate-ping` dots inside pills, or stack heavy SVG blur filters.
mechanism.zh: AI 网页模板常在首屏垫 `blur-3xl` 模糊光晕球、给按钮加彩色霓虹外发光、在胶囊徽章里放 `animate-ping` 闪烁圆点，或在 SVG 里堆砌重度模糊滤镜。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires circular/neon pairing for `blur-3xl`, >= 15px blur with high-sat cyan/purple for CSS `box-shadow`, and `rounded-full` context for `animate-ping`.

exemplar.good: <section class="surface-sheet border"><button class="btn-primary">Launch</button></section>

name.zh: 界面标题与按钮堆砌通用 Emoji

mechanism.en: Using >= 3 stock AI emojis (`🚀`, `✨`, `⚡`, `🛡️`) inside headings, buttons, or card chrome replaces intentional iconography with noisy decoration.
mechanism.zh: 在界面标题、按钮或卡片里堆砌 3 处及以上通用 Emoji（如 `🚀`、`✨`、`⚡`、`🛡️`）替代规范图标或纯字排版。

falsePositiveGuards: Only counts UI chrome tags (`h1`-`h4`, `button`, `a`, `span`, `div`, `text`) and triggers at >= 3 occurrences; prose paragraphs are exempt.

exemplar.bad:
🚀 Fast

⚡ Sync

🛡️ Safe
exemplar.trap:
🌟 Fast

💎 Sync

🎯 Safe
exemplar.good:
Sub-50 ms checks

Local sync

Offline by default

name.en: Tinted Icon-Tile Grid, Fake Window Dots & 01/02/03 Kickers
name.zh: 彩色圆角图标块、假三色窗口圆点与 01/02/03 编号眉题

mechanism.en: Flags three persistent generator card tropes: >= 3 pastel rounded-square icon tiles, fake macOS red-yellow-green traffic-light dots, and sequential `01`/`02`/`03` eyebrow kickers.
mechanism.zh: 集中命中生成式卡片三大套路：3 组以上马卡龙圆角图标方块、假 macOS 红黄绿窗口圆点，以及 `01`/`02`/`03` 独立编号眉题。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 3 icon tiles or full red+yellow+green adjacent dots or full `01`+`02`+`03` standalone tags; code/quote blocks are masked.

exemplar.bad:
A
B
C
exemplar.trap:
01

Speed

02

Scale

03

Trust
exemplar.good:
CLI

Checks Markdown and PPTX locally.

MCP

Connects to coding agents.

name.en: SVG Missing ViewBox, Overlapping Text & Orphaned Defs
name.zh: SVG 缺失 viewBox、文字坐标碰撞与冗余 defs

mechanism.en: AI-generated SVG diagrams frequently omit `viewBox` on large canvases, place `<text>` elements at colliding coordinates within the same `<g>` scope, or leave orphaned unused IDs in `<defs>`.
mechanism.zh: 模型直出的 SVG 图解常在大画布上漏写 `viewBox`、把多段 `<text>` 叠在同一组坐标上，或在 `<defs>` 里留下未被引用的孤立定义。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts small icons (< 120x80), compares `<text>` coordinates strictly inside the same `<g transform>` scope, and requires >= 2 orphaned `<defs>` IDs.

exemplar.bad: <svg width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="42" y="52">Overlap</text></svg>
exemplar.trap: <svg viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><defs><linearGradient id="u1"/><linearGradient id="u2"/></defs><rect width="640" height="360"/></svg>
exemplar.good: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="40" y="96">Step 2</text></svg>

name.en: Image Embedded AI Workflow Parameters & Provenance
name.zh: 图片内嵌 AI 工作流提示词残留与来源标识

mechanism.en: Detects unstripped A1111/ComfyUI prompt/node-graph chunks in PNG/JPEG/WebP (`warning`) as well as C2PA or `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` provenance tags (`info`, preserving legal disclosure).
mechanism.zh: 识别 PNG/JPEG/WebP 中未清理的 A1111/ComfyUI 提示词与工作流块（提醒），并标出 C2PA / `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` 法定来源标记（提示，严禁私自剥除合规标识）。

falsePositiveGuards: Distinguishes raw prompt/workflow leaks (warning) from legal C2PA/IPTC disclosures (info); standard camera EXIF passes cleanly.

exemplar.bad: PNG tEXt chunk `parameters`: `masterpiece, neon glow\nNegative prompt: blurry\nSteps: 28, Sampler: Euler a, CFG scale: 7`
exemplar.trap: Stripping legal C2PA / `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` provenance tags instead of inspecting or re-shooting the asset
exemplar.good: Clean PNG/JPEG export with raw prompt/node-graph chunks removed and natural photographic or editorial raster assets

name.en: PNG Neon Purple-Pink Palette & Plastic Smoothness
name.zh: PNG 霓虹紫粉配色与高饱和塑料质感

mechanism.en: Samples decoded 8-bit PNG pixels to flag dark-neon purple/cyan dominance or hyper-saturated airbrushed regions lacking natural micro-contrast.
mechanism.zh: 对解码后的 8 位 PNG 采样，提示高占比蓝紫霓虹渐变或缺乏自然纹理微对比的高饱和“塑料涂抹感”。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires width/height >= 64, excludes transparent pixels, requires neutralRatio < 0.75, and checks 4-neighbor smoothness on high-saturation areas.

exemplar.bad: 1024x1024 dark-mode hero PNG with 42% #0B0B14 dark backdrop and 28% glowing #7C3AED/#EC4899 purple-pink pixels
exemplar.trap: 1024x1024 PNG pushing every surface to 92% saturation with airbrushed zero-texture gradients
exemplar.good: 1024x1024 PNG on #F6F7F5 paper ground with crisp ink typography and <= 5% single vermilion accent

name.en: PDF Slide Raster-Only Deck, Flat Type Scale & Monotony
name.zh: PDF 全图无字演示稿、字阶扁平与连页单调

mechanism.en: Parses PDF pages and content streams to flag multi-page raster-only landscape decks, collapsed title-to-body type scales (< 1.2x or < 9.5pt body), and 4+ identical plain-text landscape pages.
mechanism.zh: 解析 PDF 页面与内容流，捕捉多页纯图无可选文字幻灯片、横版页标题正文倍率不足 1.2 倍或正文 < 9.5pt，以及连续 4 页及以上同骨架纯字页。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts portrait prose reports from slide density/monotony rules and skips encrypted PDFs honestly instead of faking 0 findings.

exemplar.bad: 4-page landscape 960x540 PDF deck where every slide is a single rasterized PNG image with 0 selectable text operators
exemplar.trap: 4-page landscape PDF deck shrinking all body text to 8.5pt with 10pt titles (1.17x ratio) to cram paragraphs
exemplar.good: 5-page landscape PDF deck with 28pt assertion headlines, 13pt body copy, and alternating tables and charts

name.zh: 第二代“伪人文精致模板”组合特征

mechanism.en: Flags pages that avoid neon purple gradients only to collapse into the second-order default: warm-cream + terracotta palette, serif-italic headline emphasis, untouched Inter stack, and tracked-uppercase eyebrows inside rounded-2xl shells.
mechanism.zh: 捕捉避开紫粉渐变后坍缩到第二代默认模版的页面：暖米白加陶土红配色、标题斜体强调词、Inter 默认字体与宽字距全大写眉题中同时命中 2 项及以上。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 2 distinct Gen-2 signals to co-occur in the same view so single legitimate choices (e.g., Inter alone) pass cleanly.

Studio

Built for clarity

exemplar.good: Release Notes v2.4
